hazards.evidence: Black electric range is fully accessible with exposed control knobs (no knob covers or stove lock); towels are draped over the oven door within reach of the cooktop, creating burn/fire risk for someone with dementia.
Pump/soap bottles and other small toiletry/cleaning-type bottles are left out on the counter by the sink and on the rear counter; base cabinets show no visible safety locks.
